# Vishnu Sai Jaswanth

Backend and applied AI engineer (4+ years) in Bengaluru, India. Founding engineer at 10x Productivity, where he designed and owns the backend and agent platform behind Archer, a creative-strategy product used in 10+ brand pilots.

## Experience

- 10x Productivity, Senior Software Development Engineer, founding team (Oct 2025 – present)
  - Archer's backend and agent platform: async ingestion from the Meta Marketing API, Ad Library and AppMagic on BullMQ with Redis leader election, covering 100+ competitor brands
  - Charlie, a Claude-based strategy agent (tool use, on-demand skills, parallel evidence gathering, recall across sessions, prompt caching), plus an OAuth 2.1 MCP server exposing the same tools to Claude and Cursor
  - Guardrailed workflow agents: a Meta lead-ads agent with a person approving every launch, and a media-buyer agent checked against computed figures and reviewed by a critic model
  - Multimodal ad analysis run on 15k+ ads, and Creative X-Ray, a pre-launch brand-guideline check
  - Knowledge platform (SQL analytics plus cached LLM insights) grounding the agents, 13+ report types and creative generation; in a brand pilot, strategists accepted 85% of the AI-generated creative briefs they reviewed
  - Tenant- and feature-level LLM cost attribution across 60+ call sites; Terraform AWS platform with 7 ECS Fargate services
- BIK.AI, SDE-2 (Jan 2025 – Oct 2025): embedding-based clustering of failed chatbot responses; CRM integrations (Salesforce, Zendesk, Gorgias) for 50+ clients; cut Elasticsearch cost 50% at 300M events a month; Best Employee of the Quarter (Apr 2025)
- BLKBOX.AI, SDE-1 to SDE-3 (Aug 2022 – Dec 2024): 20+ APIs, scene-level image and video analysis with AWS Rekognition, AppMagic competitor analytics, 40% faster PostgreSQL analytics queries
- HP R&D, Software Engineering Intern (Jan 2022 – Jul 2022)

## Side projects

- Wellread (https://trywellread.com/): shows what ChatGPT and Gemini tell a business's buyers, and drafts the pages that would close the gap
- Letterport (https://letterport.dev/): email inboxes for AI agents, with clean JSON mail, signed webhooks and a hosted MCP server
- RapidMock (https://www.rapidmock.com/): API mocking for frontend teams

## Skills

AI agents, tool calling, MCP, LangGraph, RAG, embeddings, LLM evals, multimodal pipelines, structured outputs, Claude, Gemini and OpenAI APIs; TypeScript, Python, SQL; Node.js, NestJS, BullMQ; PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, AWS, Terraform, Docker.

## Education

B.Tech in Computer Science, Pondicherry Engineering College (2018–2022), GPA 8.67/10.
